notes.title: Updated on June 3rd
notes.content:
1. Adjust the performance of the game UI at different resolutions
2. After the second playthrough, there is no need to defeat bosses. You can exchange the symbols of all bosses defeated in the previous playthrough at Hoshigawa Sara (a new save needs to be created to fully take effect)

notes.title: Updated on May 29th
notes.content:
1. The range of item picking has increased
2. Players can now run in the seaweed pavilion
3. Fixed the issue where Usada Bomb could not be thrown
4. The texture quality of the picture quality options is now available
5. Modified some UI issues
6. Modified the materials of some buildings
7. Some optimizations to reduce lag

notes.title: Updated on May 25th
notes.content:
1. Optimized evasion actions, players will not automatically dodge after ending their conversation with NPCs.
2. Players will deduct their stamina while running, and the run will automatically end when their stamina reaches zero.
3. Fixed the issue of missing text in NPC dialogue tips in both English and Japanese.
4. Adjusted the layout of the UI for dialogue with NPCs and fixed the issue of text exceeding the box in English and Japanese.
5. Adjusted the actions and AI of some bosses.
